item.title: Today Marks the 60th Birthday of Monolith Soft's Tetsuya Takahashi
item.author: invalid@example.com (Zeal543)
item.dc:creator: Zeal543
item.content:encoded: Happy birthday to a legend and one of the best to do it in the jRPG space. Takahashi was involved with Falcom and Squaresoft during their respective golden years before establishing/co-founding Monolith Soft. Best known for the Xeno series but also had a hand in other major series like Final Fantasy and Chrono. Here's wishing to a successful new arc with Xenoblade and whatever else may come.
